SELECT g.ID, g.SEX, g.group_average, g.group_average - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, (g.group_average - o.overall_average) - s.sex_average AS difference_minus_sex_average
FROM (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS group_average
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
) AS g
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average
  FROM (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS group_average
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
  )
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT sex, AVG(difference) AS sex_average
  FROM (
    SELECT g2.SEX AS sex, g2.group_average - o2.overall_average AS difference
    FROM (
      SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS group_average
      FROM Examination AS e
      JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
      GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
    ) AS g2
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average
      FROM (
        SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS group_average
        FROM Examination AS e
        JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
        GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
      )
    ) AS o2
  )
  GROUP BY sex
) AS s ON g.SEX = s.sex
WHERE g.group_average - o.overall_average > s.sex_average
ORDER BY difference_minus_sex_average DESC
LIMIT 10
